title: pesto — design
summary: Technical design for pesto, a local desktop app for exploring PEST++ IES results from MODFLOW 6 runs, covering ingest, cache layout, API, and UI.
notes: Path convention */specs/* plus dominant SPEC content: endpoint tables, on-disk storage layout, Protocol/TypeScript interface definitions, performance targets, module tables. Date prefix 2026-08-12 is not an ADR sequence number. Status field reads 'approved, ready for implementation planning' — not an ADR Accepted status, so locked=false. Contains embedded decisions and milestone scoping but no ADR Context/Decision/Consequences structure and no user stories/acceptance criteria.
